title: Spending a Named Circle Benefit Credit Against a Charge
content:
## One redemption of a named credit to one charge

A named benefit credit on a Northbeam Circle Membership that already has a redemption booked against the
same charge reference is not redeemed a second time. The test is made on the redemptions already booked
on that membership against that charge reference, read from the ledger before the credit is spent; two
redemptions of the same named credit against one charge reference are the same redemption even where they
fall on different days or come through different channels.

## What a credit may never be spent against

A credit is never spent against tax, against dues, or against the price of merchandise.

## Where the charge is later reversed

Where the charge is later reversed the credit is restored by a fresh grant carrying the same named
benefit, and the original redemption row stays on file.

## Clauses of this policy no longer in force

Three clauses of this policy are **no longer in force**:

1. The clause spending a benefit credit only against a charge of the kind the benefit names — the
   installation credit against installation labour, the delivery credit against a delivery charge, the
   haul-away credit against a haul-away charge, and the service credit against bench or on-site repair
   labour.
2. The clause applying, on a tier allowing only one credit per charge, the credit that left the customer
   paying least and leaving the others unspent, and applying credits together up to the value of the
   charge and never beyond it on a tier that is additive.
3. The clause refusing further redemptions until the next anniversary once the membership had booked as
   many redemptions in the membership year as the tier allows, counted as the benefit redemptions booked
   in the current membership year, from the activation anniversary on or before the handling date to the
   day before the next anniversary.

The stacking basis and the yearly redemption allowance recorded for each tier remain figures of the tier.

## Cases on the duplicate test

A membership that has already spent its service credit against one charge reference cannot spend the
service credit against that same reference again, and a second attempt on a later day through a different
channel is still the same redemption. Where the charge carrying that redemption is afterwards reversed,
the credit comes back as a fresh grant under the same named benefit and the earlier redemption row is
left on the ledger.

superseded_clauses: A benefit credit is spent only against a charge of the kind the benefit names: the installation credit against installation labour, the delivery credit against a delivery charge, the haul-away credit against a haul-away charge, and the service credit against bench or on-site repair labour.

Where the tier allows only one credit per charge, the credit that leaves the customer paying least is applied and the others stay unspent; where the tier is additive, credits are applied together up to the value of the charge and never beyond it.

Once the membership has booked as many redemptions in the membership year as the tier allows, measured by membership_msr_benefit_redemptions_term, further redemptions are refused until the next anniversary.
